name: 可持续金融
description: 重构全球资本流向，为绿色未来注入澎湃动力。从绿色债券到转型金融，从自然资本定价到ESG 2.0，重塑金融市场的底层逻辑。
descriptionEn: Reconstructing global capital flows to inject vigorous momentum into a green future. From green bonds to transformation finance, from natural capital pricing to ESG 2.0, reshaping the underlying logic of financial markets.

name: 可持续贸易
description: 从“规则时代”到“行动时代”的第三次跃迁。应对CBAM、DPP等新规则，将绿色从“例外”变为“基准”，重塑全球贸易的“操作系统”。
descriptionEn: The third leap from the "era of rules" to the "era of action". In response to new rules such as CBAM and DPP, we should transform green from an "exception" to a "benchmark" and reshape the "operating system" of global trade.

name: 供应链转型
description: 解码Scope 3，从合规到竞争力。将供应链从“成本-效率”范式转向“韧性-绿色-透明”范式，解锁绿色增长密码。同时，通过赋能中国最具活力的中小企业群体，将中国绿色力量转化为全球供应链转型的动力。
descriptionEn: Decoding Scope 3, from compliance to competitiveness. Shift the supply chain from a "cost-efficiency" paradigm to a "resilience-green-transparency" paradigm, unlocking the code for green growth. At the same time, by empowering China's most dynamic SMEs, we aim to transform China's green power into a driving force for global supply chain transformation.

name: 领导力和治理
description: 从国家驱动到多主体共治。推动企业董事会设立气候委员会，强化城市气候行动领导力，构建政府、企业、金融机构、青年、国际组织共同治理的新生态。
descriptionEn: From state-driven to multi-stakeholder co-governance. Promote the establishment of climate committees in corporate boards, strengthen leadership in urban climate action, and build a new ecosystem of co-governance among governments, enterprises, financial institutions, youth, and international organizations.

name: 未来科技
description: 新质生产力 × 气候科技 × AI，以科技重构未来，以资本加速规模化。站在绿色科技革命的起点，加速下一代绿色科技与AI的融合与规模化应用。
descriptionEn: New productivity × climate technology × AI, using technology to reshape the future and capital to accelerate scale. Standing at the starting point of the green technology revolution, we are accelerating the integration and large-scale application of the next generation of green technology and AI.

name: 可持续产品
description: 为中国构建下一代“可持续产品出海操作系统”。未来的竞争将从企业碳中和转向产品本身的可持续性。评选并推广100款代表未来的绿色产品，定义可持续消费新标准。
descriptionEn: Build the next-generation "sustainable product globalization operating system" for China. Future competition will shift from corporate carbon neutrality to the sustainability of products themselves. Select and promote 100 green products that represent the future, and define new standards for sustainable consumption.

name: 绿色先进制造
description: 从中国制造2025到“十五五”。推动传统制造业向绿色、智能、高端升级，将国家战略与全球循环再生和绿色供应链需求深度结合。
descriptionEn: From "Made in China 2025" to the "15th Five-Year Plan", we aim to promote the upgrading of traditional manufacturing industries towards green, intelligent, and high-end development, deeply integrating national strategies with global recycling and green supply chain demands.

name: 可持续基础设施
description: Resilience by Design（韧性设计）。全球60%的排放来自基础设施。推动基础设施从设计之初就融入气候韧性、自然正向与可融资性，应对极端气候挑战。
descriptionEn: Resilience by Design. 60% of global emissions originate from infrastructure. We advocate for the integration of climate resilience, natural positive features, and bankability into infrastructure design from the outset, to address extreme climate challenges.

name: 亚太水安全
description: 创新驱动水安全：气候适应、韧性与可持续发展。水安全是气候适应的核心入口。汇聚亚太力量，共同应对水资源危机，推动技术创新与区域治理。
descriptionEn: Innovation-driven Water Security: Climate Adaptation, Resilience, and Sustainable Development. Water security serves as a core entry point for climate adaptation. By pooling the strengths of the Asia-Pacific region, we aim to jointly tackle the water crisis and promote technological innovation and regional governance.

name: 未来食物系统
description: 从农场到餐桌的净零之路。应对占全球排放三分之一的食品系统挑战，推动气候智能型农业、减少粮食损耗、构建可持续供应链。
descriptionEn: The net-zero journey from farm to table. Addressing the challenges of the food system, which accounts for one-third of global emissions, by promoting climate-smart agriculture, reducing food loss, and building sustainable supply chains.

name: 自然向正发展
description: 确保气候行动公平惠及所有群体，关注弱势群体需求，推动包容性气候治理。
descriptionEn: Investing in nature is investing in our future. We should promote the pricing of natural capital, protect biodiversity, explore Nature-Based Solutions (NbS), and achieve the goal of being "Nature Positive".

name: U20青年人才
description: 不是在培养“未来的青年领袖”，而是在10–20岁这个最关键的窗口期，为世界“预备”一代能够用设计思维、行为科学和AI解决气候与可持续挑战的系统领导者。
descriptionEn: It's not about cultivating "future young leaders", but rather about "preparing" a generation of system leaders for the world during the most critical window period of 10-20 years old, who are capable of solving climate and sustainability challenges using design thinking, behavioral science, and AI.

name: CONNECT+国际协作
description: 不脱钩，推共建；不封闭，强联通。打造中国与全球各区域在绿色技术、政策、资本与产业合作上的旗舰交流平台。
descriptionEn: Do not decouple, promote joint construction; do not close off, strengthen connectivity. Build a flagship exchange platform for China and various regions around the world in terms of green technology, policy, capital, and industrial cooperation.
